depiction.primary_object: small gabled building with a wide half-lowered roll-up door

readings.meaning: open garage or raised garage door

ambiguity: Easily confused with the closed garage icon (which has three full slats and a closed bottom), and for general garage or storage tasks the two are largely interchangeable; the doorway alone can also resemble a block letter A inside a house.

reasoning: Shows a small gabled building with a wide doorway and a partially lowered horizontal bar representing an overhead garage door. It fits tasks centered on a home garage, garage door maintenance, sheds, or self-storage units, though at tiny sizes it shares a silhouette with a plain house.

pass1.ambiguity: Can be mistaken for a generic house icon at very small sizes, or for a capital letter A under a roof.
